div.p: Retain sample SF14-R3 has no final assay result. Two confirmed checks do not establish sterility; maintain quarantine until Microbiology supplies the result and Quality reviews the complete packet.

div.p: Two of three release checks are confirmed. The 48-hour sterility assay for retain sample SF14-R3 is not in the packet; the other checks cannot establish sterility. A rapid test is available tonight, but the lab has not confirmed instrument capacity. Keep the batch quarantined until a qualified result is attached and reviewed by Quality.
